es.R: Entonces Eliseo recogió el manto que se le había caído a Elías. Volvió y se detuvo a la orilla del río Jordán.

fr.L: Et il ramassa le manteau d’Élie qui était tombé de dessus lui, et il retourna et se tint sur la rive du Jourdain.
fr.B: Il ramassa le manteau d’Élie, qui était tombé de dessus lui, revint sur ses pas et se tint au bord du Jourdain.
fr.R: Ensuite Élisée a ramassé le manteau qui était tombé des épaules d’Élie. Il est revenu et il s’est arrêté au bord du Jourdain.

sw.L: Akaliokota vazi la Eliya lililoanguka kutoka kwake, akarudi, akasimama ukingoni mwa Yordani.
sw.B: Akaliokota vazi la Eliya lililokuwa limeanguka kutoka kwake, akarudi, akasimama ukingoni mwa Yordani.
sw.R: Kisha Elisha akaliokota lile vazi lililoanguka kutoka kwa Eliya. Akarudi, akasimama ukingoni mwa mto Yordani.

vi.L: Ông nhặt áo choàng của Ê-li đã rơi xuống từ người Ê-li, rồi trở lại và đứng trên bờ sông Giô-đanh.
vi.B: Ông nhặt chiếc áo choàng đã rơi xuống từ người Ê-li, rồi quay lại đứng trên bờ sông Giô-đanh.
vi.R: Rồi Ê-li-sê nhặt chiếc áo choàng đã rơi xuống từ người Ê-li. Ông quay lại và đứng trên bờ sông Giô-đanh.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 엘리야에게서 떨어진 엘리야의 겉옷을 집어 들고, 돌아가서 요단강 둑에 섰다.
ko.B: 그는 엘리야에게서 떨어진 엘리야의 겉옷을 집어 들고 돌아가서 요단강 가에 섰다.
ko.R: 엘리사는 엘리야에게서 떨어진 겉옷을 집어 들었다. 그리고 돌아가서 요단강 가에 섰다.

decisions.choice: the cloak that had fallen from him: Elijah's office passes to Elisha
decisions.reason: When Elijah called Elisha he threw this cloak over him (1 Kings 19:19). Now it has fallen from Elijah, and Elisha takes it up as the one who inherits his place.

decisions.choice: Elisha; the Jordan River
decisions.reason: Readable names Elisha and adds "River" for clarity.

source.text: וַיִּקַּח֩ אֶת־אַדֶּ֨רֶת אֵלִיָּ֜הוּ אֲשֶׁר־נָפְלָ֤ה מֵֽעָלָיו֙ וַיַּכֶּ֣ה אֶת־הַמַּ֔יִם וַיֹּאמַ֕ר אַיֵּ֕ה יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֵלִיָּ֑הוּ אַף־ה֣וּא׀וַיַּכֶּ֣ה אֶת־הַמַּ֗יִם וַיֵּֽחָצוּ֙ הֵ֣נָּה וָהֵ֔נָּה וַֽיַּעֲבֹ֖ר אֱלִישָֽׁע׃

records.literal_gloss: And he took the cloak of Elijah which had fallen from on him, and struck the waters and said, Where [is] Yahweh, [the] God of Elijah? Also he, and he struck the waters, and they were divided here and here; and crossed Elisha.

en.L: And he took the cloak of Elijah that had fallen from him and struck the waters, and said, "Where [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Elijah?" He also, when he had struck the waters, they were divided this way and that way, and Elisha crossed over.
en.B: He took Elijah's cloak that had fallen from him, struck the water and said, "Where is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Elijah?" When he too had struck the water, it divided to one side and the other, and Elisha crossed over.
en.R: He took the cloak that had fallen from Elijah and hit the water with it. "Where is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Elijah?" he asked. When Elisha also had struck the water, it split apart, part to one side and part to the other. And Elisha walked across.

es.L: Y tomó el manto de Elías que había caído de sobre él, y golpeó las aguas, y dijo: «¿Dónde [está] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Elías?». También él, cuando golpeó las aguas, se dividieron a un lado y a otro, y pasó Eliseo.
es.B: Tomó el manto de Elías que se le había caído, golpeó el agua y dijo: «¿Dónde está {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Elías?». Cuando también él golpeó el agua, esta se dividió a un lado y a otro, y Eliseo cruzó.
es.R: Tomó el manto que se le había caído a Elías y golpeó el agua con él. «¿Dónde está {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Elías?», preguntó. Cuando Eliseo también golpeó el agua, esta se abrió, una parte hacia un lado y otra hacia el otro. Y Eliseo cruzó caminando.

fr.L: Et il prit le manteau d’Élie qui était tombé de dessus lui, et frappa les eaux, et dit : « Où [est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Élie ? » Lui aussi, il frappa les eaux, et elles se divisèrent de-ci et de-là, et Élisée passa.
fr.B: Il prit le manteau d’Élie, qui était tombé de dessus lui, frappa l’eau et dit : « Où est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Élie ? » Quand il eut frappé l’eau à son tour, elle se partagea d’un côté et de l’autre, et Élisée traversa.
fr.R: Il a pris le manteau qui était tombé des épaules d’Élie et il a frappé l’eau avec. « Où est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Élie ? » a-t-il demandé. Quand Élisée a frappé l’eau à son tour, elle s’est séparée : une partie d’un côté, une partie de l’autre. Et Élisée a traversé à pied.

sw.L: Akalitwaa vazi la Eliya lililoanguka kutoka kwake, akayapiga maji, akasema, "Yuko wapi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Eliya?" Yeye naye alipoyapiga maji, yakagawanyika huku na huku, naye Elisha akavuka.
sw.B: Akalichukua vazi la Eliya lililokuwa limeanguka kutoka kwake, akayapiga maji, akasema, "Yuko wapi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Eliya?" Naye alipoyapiga maji, yakagawanyika upande huu na upande huu, naye Elisha akavuka.
sw.R: Akalichukua lile vazi lililoanguka kutoka kwa Eliya, akayapiga maji kwa vazi hilo. Akauliza, "Yuko wapi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Eliya?" Elisha naye alipoyapiga maji, yakagawanyika, sehemu moja upande mmoja na sehemu nyingine upande mwingine. Naye Elisha akavuka.

vi.L: Ông lấy áo choàng của Ê-li đã rơi xuống từ người Ê-li, đập xuống nước và nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Ê-li, ở đâu?" Khi ông cũng đập xuống nước, nước rẽ ra bên này và bên kia, và Ê-li-sê đi qua.
vi.B: Ông lấy chiếc áo choàng đã rơi xuống từ người Ê-li, đập xuống nước và nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Ê-li, ở đâu?" Khi ông cũng đập xuống nước, nước rẽ ra hai bên, và Ê-li-sê đi qua.
vi.R: Ông lấy chiếc áo choàng đã rơi xuống từ người Ê-li và đập xuống mặt nước. Ông hỏi: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Ê-li, đang ở đâu?" Khi Ê-li-sê cũng đập xuống nước, nước tách ra, một phần sang bên này, một phần sang bên kia. Rồi Ê-li-sê đi bộ qua sông.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 엘리야에게서 떨어진 엘리야의 겉옷을 가지고 물을 치며 말했다. "엘리야의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 어디 [계십니까]?" 그도 물을 치자, 물이 이쪽과 저쪽으로 갈라졌고, 엘리사가 건너갔다.
ko.B: 그는 엘리야에게서 떨어진 겉옷을 가지고 물을 치며 말했다. "엘리야의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 어디 계십니까?" 그가 물을 치자, 물이 이쪽저쪽으로 갈라졌고, 엘리사는 건너갔다.
ko.R: 그는 엘리야에게서 떨어진 겉옷을 가지고 물을 쳤다. 그리고 외쳤다. "엘리야의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 어디 계십니까?" 엘리사도 물을 치자, 물이 이쪽과 저쪽으로 갈라졌다. 그리고 엘리사는 걸어서 건너갔다.

decisions.choice: Where is Yahweh, the God of Elijah?: a call on Yahweh to act now as he acted for Elijah
decisions.reason: Elisha is not doubting. He calls on Elijah's God to show that he is with Elisha too, and the waters divide as they did for Elijah (verse 8). It is the first sign that Elijah's spirit is on him (verse 15).

decisions.choice: "he also" begins the next clause: when he too struck the water
alternatives: Where is Yahweh, the God of Elijah, even he?
decisions.reason: The Hebrew accents end Elisha's question at "the God of Elijah" and join "he also" to what follows: Elisha also, like Elijah before him, struck the water. The words could instead end the question: "Where is Yahweh, the God of Elijah, even he?"

decisions.choice: struck the water twice: one action told twice
alternatives: the water did not part at the first stroke
decisions.reason: The verse first tells that Elisha struck the water and spoke, then repeats "he struck the water" to tell what followed. It most likely means one striking, not a first that failed and a second that worked.

decisions.choice: divided this way and that, and Elisha crossed: as Joshua followed Moses
decisions.reason: Elisha repeats Elijah's miracle (verse 8), as Joshua led Israel through the Jordan after Moses had led them through the sea (Joshua 3:7; 4:14, 23). Elisha comes back into the land by the way Israel first entered it.

decisions.choice: Elisha's question "어디 계십니까?" is in the polite style, as a call to God
decisions.reason: The question is a call on the LORD to act (m1); people speaking to or calling on God use 합쇼체 in these drafts.

source.text: וַיִּרְאֻ֨הוּ בְנֵֽי־הַנְּבִיאִ֤ים אֲשֶׁר־בִּֽירִיחוֹ֙ מִנֶּ֔גֶד וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ נָ֛חָה ר֥וּחַ אֵלִיָּ֖הוּ עַל־אֱלִישָׁ֑ע וַיָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ לִקְרָאת֔וֹ וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ־ל֖וֹ אָֽרְצָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And saw him [the] sons of the prophets who [were] at Jericho from opposite, and they said, Has rested [the] spirit of Elijah on Elisha; and they came to meet him and bowed down to him to [the] ground.

en.L: And the sons of the prophets who [were] at Jericho saw him from opposite, and they said, "The spirit of Elijah has come to rest on Elisha." And they came to meet him and bowed down to him to the ground.
en.B: When the company of prophets from Jericho, who were watching from the other side, saw him, they said, "The spirit of Elijah has come to rest on Elisha." They went to meet him and bowed to the ground before him.
en.R: The group of prophets from Jericho had been watching from a distance. When they saw what Elisha did, they said, "The spirit of Elijah is now on Elisha." They went to meet him, and they bowed down to the ground in front of him.

es.L: Y lo vieron los hijos de los profetas que [estaban] en Jericó, desde enfrente, y dijeron: «El espíritu de Elías ha reposado sobre Eliseo». Y vinieron a su encuentro y se postraron ante él hasta el suelo.
es.B: Cuando los discípulos de los profetas de Jericó, que observaban desde la otra orilla, lo vieron, dijeron: «El espíritu de Elías reposa sobre Eliseo». Fueron a su encuentro y se postraron ante él hasta el suelo.
es.R: El grupo de profetas de Jericó había estado mirando desde lejos. Cuando vieron lo que hizo Eliseo, dijeron: «Ahora el espíritu de Elías está sobre Eliseo». Fueron a su encuentro y se inclinaron delante de él hasta el suelo.

fr.L: Et les fils des prophètes qui [étaient] à Jéricho le virent d’en face, et ils dirent : « L’esprit d’Élie repose sur Élisée. » Et ils vinrent à sa rencontre et se prosternèrent devant lui jusqu’à terre.
fr.B: Les disciples des prophètes de Jéricho, qui regardaient de l’autre côté, le virent et dirent : « L’esprit d’Élie repose sur Élisée. » Ils allèrent à sa rencontre et se prosternèrent jusqu’à terre devant lui.
fr.R: Le groupe de prophètes de Jéricho regardait de loin. Quand ils ont vu ce qu’Élisée avait fait, ils ont dit : « Maintenant l’esprit d’Élie est sur Élisée. » Ils sont allés à sa rencontre et se sont inclinés jusqu’à terre devant lui.

sw.L: Wana wa manabii waliokuwa huko Yeriko wakamwona kutoka ng'ambo, wakasema, "Roho ya Eliya imetua juu ya Elisha." Wakaja kumlaki, wakamsujudia hadi chini.
sw.B: Kundi la manabii kutoka Yeriko, waliokuwa wakitazama kutoka ng'ambo, walipomwona, walisema, "Roho ya Eliya imetua juu ya Elisha." Wakaenda kumlaki, wakainama mpaka chini mbele yake.
sw.R: Kundi la manabii kutoka Yeriko lilikuwa likitazama kwa mbali. Walipoona alichofanya Elisha, walisema, "Roho ya Eliya sasa iko juu ya Elisha." Wakaenda kumlaki, wakainama mpaka chini mbele yake.

vi.L: Các con trai của các nhà tiên tri ở Giê-ri-cô thấy ông từ phía đối diện, và họ nói: "Thần linh của Ê-li đã đậu trên Ê-li-sê." Họ đến đón ông và sấp mình xuống đất trước mặt ông.
vi.B: Đoàn tiên tri từ Giê-ri-cô đang đứng nhìn ở phía bên kia thấy ông thì nói: "Thần linh của Ê-li đã ngự trên Ê-li-sê." Họ đến đón ông và sấp mình xuống đất trước mặt ông.
vi.R: Đoàn tiên tri từ Giê-ri-cô đã đứng nhìn từ xa. Khi thấy việc Ê-li-sê làm, họ nói: "Bây giờ thần linh của Ê-li ở trên Ê-li-sê." Họ đến đón ông và cúi rạp xuống đất trước mặt ông.

ko.L: 그리고 맞은편 여리고에 있던 예언자의 아들들이 그를 보고 말했다. "엘리야의 영이 엘리사 위에 머물렀다." 그리고 그들이 그를 맞으러 와서 그에게 땅에 엎드려 절했다.
ko.B: 맞은편에서 지켜보던 여리고의 예언자 무리가 그를 보고 말했다. "엘리야의 영이 엘리사 위에 머물러 있다." 그들은 그를 맞으러 나와서 그 앞에서 땅에 엎드려 절했다.
ko.R: 여리고의 예언자 무리는 멀리서 지켜보고 있었다. 그들은 엘리사가 한 일을 보고 말했다. "이제 엘리야의 영이 엘리사에게 있다." 그들은 엘리사를 맞으러 나와서 그 앞에서 땅에 엎드려 절했다.

decisions.choice: the spirit of Elijah has rested on Elisha: Elijah's prophetic power now works in Elisha
decisions.reason: The prophets see the sign at the river and know that Elisha has received what he asked for (verses 9-10). The spirit is Elijah's in the sense that it worked through him; it comes from Yahweh (verse 16; Numbers 11:25).

decisions.choice: bowed down to the ground: they accept Elisha as their leader
decisions.reason: Bowing to the ground was a sign of deep respect, given to a king or a master. The prophets now honor Elisha as they did Elijah.

decisions.choice: from opposite: from where they stood watching across the river
decisions.reason: The fifty prophets had stood at a distance facing the river (verse 7). They saw Elisha come back across it.

decisions.choice: saw what Elisha did
decisions.reason: Readable says what they saw: the water parting at Elisha's stroke, which is why they speak of Elijah's spirit.

decisions.choice: "roho ya Eliya" (class 9, lower case)
decisions.reason: Elijah's spirit is the prophetic power at work in him, not the Spirit of the LORD named in the next verse, so it takes the ordinary agreement of "roho" ("roho ya ... imetua"), while "Roho wa BWANA" takes personal agreement, as in Samuel.

source.text: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֡יו הִנֵּה־נָ֣א יֵֽשׁ־אֶת־עֲבָדֶיךָ֩ חֲמִשִּׁ֨ים אֲנָשִׁ֜ים בְּנֵֽי־חַ֗יִל יֵ֣לְכוּ נָא֮ וִיבַקְשׁ֣וּ אֶת־אֲדֹנֶיךָ֒ פֶּן־נְשָׂאוֹ֙ ר֣וּחַ יְהוָ֔ה וַיַּשְׁלִכֵ֨הוּ֙ בְּאַחַ֣ד הֶהָרִ֔ים א֖וֹ בְּאַחַ֣ת הַגֵּאָי֑וֹת וַיֹּ֖אמֶר לֹ֥א תִשְׁלָֽחוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And they said to him, Look please, there are with your servants fifty men, sons of strength; let them go please and search for your master, lest has carried him [the] Spirit of Yahweh and has thrown him on one of the mountains or into one of the valleys; and he said, Not you shall send.

en.L: And they said to him, "Look, please, there are with your servants fifty men, sons of strength. Let them go, please, and search for your master, in case the Spirit of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has carried him off and thrown him on one of the mountains or into one of the valleys." And he said, "You shall not send [them]."
en.B: They said to him, "Look, we your servants have fifty strong men with us. Please let them go and look for your master. It may be that the Spirit of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has carried him off and set him down on some mountain or in some valley." But he said, "Do not send them."
en.R: They said to Elisha, "Look, we your servants have fifty strong men here. Please let them go and look for your master. Maybe the Spirit of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has picked him up and dropped him on some mountain or in some valley." But Elisha said, "No, do not send them."

es.L: Y le dijeron: «He aquí, te rogamos, que hay con tus siervos cincuenta hombres, hijos de valor. Que vayan, te rogamos, y busquen a tu señor, no sea que el Espíritu {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} lo haya llevado y lo haya arrojado en alguno de los montes o en alguno de los valles». Y él dijo: «No {{plural_you:envíen|enviéis}} [a nadie]».
es.B: Le dijeron: «Mira, nosotros tus siervos tenemos aquí cincuenta hombres fuertes. Deja que vayan a buscar a tu maestro. Puede ser que el Espíritu {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} se lo haya llevado y lo haya dejado en algún monte o en algún valle». Pero él dijo: «No los {{plural_you:envíen|enviéis}}».
es.R: Le dijeron a Eliseo: «Mira, nosotros tus siervos tenemos aquí cincuenta hombres fuertes. Por favor, deja que vayan a buscar a tu maestro. Tal vez el Espíritu {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} lo levantó y lo dejó caer en algún monte o en algún valle». Pero Eliseo dijo: «No, no los {{plural_you:envíen|enviéis}}».

fr.L: Et ils lui dirent : « Voici, je te prie, il y a avec tes serviteurs cinquante hommes, fils de vaillance. Qu’ils aillent, je te prie, chercher ton maître, de peur que l’Esprit {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ne l’ait emporté et jeté sur l’une des montagnes ou dans l’une des vallées. » Et il dit : « Vous n’enverrez pas. »
fr.B: Ils lui dirent : « Écoute, il y a parmi nous, tes serviteurs, cinquante hommes vaillants. Laisse-les aller chercher ton maître, s’il te plaît. Peut-être l’Esprit {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} l’a-t-il emporté et déposé sur quelque montagne ou dans quelque vallée. » Mais il répondit : « Ne les envoyez pas. »
fr.R: Ils ont dit à Élisée : « Écoute, nous avons ici, nous tes serviteurs, cinquante hommes forts. Laisse-les aller chercher ton maître, s’il te plaît. L’Esprit {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} l’a peut-être emporté et laissé tomber sur une montagne ou dans une vallée. » Mais Élisée a répondu : « Non, ne les envoyez pas. »

sw.L: Wakamwambia, "Tazama, tafadhali, kuna pamoja na watumishi wako watu hamsini, wana wa nguvu. Tafadhali waende wakamtafute bwana wako, isije ikawa Roho wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amemchukua na kumtupa juu ya mlima mmojawapo au katika bonde mojawapo." Akasema, "Msitume."
sw.B: Wakamwambia, "Tazama, sisi watumishi wako tuna watu hamsini wenye nguvu. Tafadhali waende wakamtafute bwana wako. Huenda Roho wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amemchukua na kumweka juu ya mlima fulani au katika bonde fulani." Lakini akasema, "Msiwatume."
sw.R: Wakamwambia Elisha, "Tazama, sisi watumishi wako tuna watu hamsini wenye nguvu hapa. Tafadhali waache waende wakamtafute bwana wako. Huenda Roho wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amemnyakua na kumwangusha juu ya mlima fulani au katika bonde fulani." Lakini Elisha akasema, "Hapana, msiwatume."

vi.L: Họ nói với ông: "Kìa, xin ông xem, có năm mươi người, là những người mạnh mẽ, ở với các đầy tớ của ông. Xin để họ đi tìm thầy của ông, kẻo Thần Linh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã cất thầy lên và ném xuống một ngọn núi nào hay một thung lũng nào." Ông nói: "Các anh đừng sai đi."
vi.B: Họ thưa với ông: "Chúng tôi, đầy tớ của ông, có năm mươi người khỏe mạnh ở đây. Xin ông để họ đi tìm thầy của ông. Có thể Thần Linh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đem thầy đi và đặt xuống một ngọn núi hay một thung lũng nào đó." Nhưng ông nói: "Đừng sai họ đi."
vi.R: Họ nói với Ê-li-sê: "Chúng tôi, đầy tớ của ông, có năm mươi người khỏe mạnh ở đây. Xin ông để họ đi tìm thầy của ông. Có lẽ Thần Linh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã nhấc thầy lên rồi thả xuống một ngọn núi hay một thung lũng nào đó." Nhưng Ê-li-sê nói: "Không, đừng sai họ đi."

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 그에게 말했다. "보십시오, 어른의 종들에게 힘센 사람 오십 명이 있습니다. 그들이 가서 어른의 주인을 찾게 해 주십시오. 혹시 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영이 그를 들어 올려 어떤 산 위나 어떤 골짜기에 던져 두셨을지도 모릅니다." 그러자 그가 말했다. "보내지 마라."
ko.B: 그들이 엘리사에게 말했다. "보십시오, 저희 어른의 종들에게 힘센 사람 오십 명이 있습니다. 그들을 보내어 어른의 스승을 찾아보게 해 주십시오. 혹시 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영이 그분을 들어 올려 어느 산이나 골짜기에 내려놓으셨을지도 모릅니다." 그러나 엘리사는 말했다. "보내지 마라."
ko.R: 그들이 엘리사에게 말했다. "보십시오, 저희에게 힘센 사람 오십 명이 있습니다. 그들을 보내어 어른의 스승을 찾아보게 해 주십시오. 혹시 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영이 그분을 들어서 어느 산이나 골짜기에 떨어뜨려 놓으셨을지도 모릅니다." 그러나 엘리사는 말했다. "아니다, 보내지 마라."

decisions.choice: your servants: a polite way of saying "we"
decisions.reason: Speaking of oneself as the other person's servant was a courteous way to address a superior (1 Samuel 25:41). The prophets now speak to Elisha as their master.

decisions.choice: sons of strength: capable, strong men
decisions.reason: "Sons of strength" means men of ability and vigor, fit for a hard search in the hills.

decisions.choice: the Spirit of Yahweh may have carried him off: a fear raised before about Elijah
decisions.reason: Obadiah once feared that the Spirit of Yahweh would carry Elijah away to some unknown place (1 Kings 18:12). The prophets think Elijah may have been set down somewhere on earth; Elisha, who saw him taken up, knows he will not be found.

decisions.choice: we your servants
decisions.reason: "Your servant" is kept at every level, as in Genesis 18:3 and 1 Samuel 20. Balanced and Readable add "we" so it is clear that the speakers mean themselves.

decisions.choice: set him down / dropped him
decisions.reason: The verb "threw" means that the Spirit put him down in some place; Balanced and Readable avoid the picture of a violent throw.

decisions.choice: tus siervos (Literal); nosotros tus siervos (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: "Tu siervo" stays at every level, as in Samuel; Balanced and Readable add "nosotros" so that it is clear the speakers mean themselves.

decisions.choice: "các đầy tớ của ông" (L); "chúng tôi, đầy tớ của ông" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Now that they have bowed to Elisha (verse 15), the prophets call themselves his servants, the polite way of saying "we" (m1).

decisions.choice: "Thần Linh của CHÚA"
decisions.reason: As the Samuel note: the Spirit of the LORD, capitalised; the prophets fear Yahweh's Spirit has carried Elijah off (m3).

decisions.choice: After bowing to Elisha (verse 15) the prophets speak to him in 합쇼체, calling him "어른" and themselves "어른의 종들" (L, B) or "저희" (R); Elisha now answers in the plain style
alternatives: keeping 하오체 on both sides as in verses 3-5
decisions.reason: The change follows the story: they have accepted Elisha as Elijah's successor and leader (m2 of verse 15).

source.text: וַיִּפְצְרוּ־ב֥וֹ עַד־בֹּ֖שׁ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁלָ֑חוּ וַֽיִּשְׁלְחוּ֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אִ֔ישׁ וַיְבַקְשׁ֥וּ שְׁלֹשָֽׁה־יָמִ֖ים וְלֹ֥א מְצָאֻֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And they urged him until being ashamed, and he said, Send; and they sent fifty men, and they searched three days and not found him.

en.L: And they pressed him until [he was] ashamed, and he said, "Send [them]." And they sent fifty men, and they searched three days but did not find him.
en.B: But they kept pressing him until he was embarrassed to refuse, so he said, "Send them." They sent fifty men, and for three days they searched but did not find him.
en.R: But they kept on begging him until he was too embarrassed to say no. So he said, "All right, send them." They sent fifty men, who looked for Elijah for three days. But they did not find him.

es.L: E insistieron con él hasta [que se] avergonzó, y dijo: «{{plural_you:Envíen|Enviad}}». Y enviaron cincuenta hombres, y buscaron tres días, pero no lo hallaron.
es.B: Pero ellos insistieron tanto que le dio vergüenza negarse, y dijo: «{{plural_you:Envíenlos|Enviadlos}}». Enviaron a cincuenta hombres, que lo buscaron durante tres días, pero no lo encontraron.
es.R: Pero ellos siguieron rogándole hasta que le dio demasiada vergüenza decir que no. Así que les dijo: «Está bien, {{plural_you:envíenlos|enviadlos}}». Enviaron a cincuenta hombres, que buscaron a Elías durante tres días, pero no lo encontraron.

fr.L: Et ils insistèrent auprès de lui jusqu’à [ce qu’il fût] gêné, et il dit : « Envoyez. » Et ils envoyèrent cinquante hommes, qui cherchèrent trois jours mais ne le trouvèrent pas.
fr.B: Mais ils insistèrent tant qu’il fut gêné de refuser, et il dit : « Envoyez-les. » Ils envoyèrent cinquante hommes, qui cherchèrent pendant trois jours sans le trouver.
fr.R: Mais ils ont tellement insisté qu’il a été trop gêné pour dire non. Alors il a dit : « D’accord, envoyez-les. » Ils ont envoyé cinquante hommes, qui ont cherché Élie pendant trois jours. Mais ils ne l’ont pas trouvé.

sw.L: Wakamsihi sana mpaka [akaona] haya, akasema, "Tumeni." Wakatuma watu hamsini, wakatafuta siku tatu, lakini hawakumwona.
sw.B: Lakini wakaendelea kumsisitiza mpaka akaona aibu kukataa, basi akasema, "Watumeni." Wakatuma watu hamsini, nao wakatafuta kwa siku tatu, lakini hawakumpata.
sw.R: Lakini waliendelea kumsihi mpaka akaona aibu kukataa. Basi akasema, "Haya, watumeni." Wakatuma watu hamsini, nao wakamtafuta Eliya kwa siku tatu. Lakini hawakumpata.

vi.L: Họ nài ép ông cho đến khi ông ngại ngùng, và ông nói: "Hãy sai đi." Họ sai năm mươi người đi, và những người này tìm kiếm ba ngày nhưng không tìm thấy Ê-li.
vi.B: Nhưng họ cứ nài ép mãi đến nỗi ông ngại không từ chối được, nên ông nói: "Các anh hãy sai họ đi." Họ sai năm mươi người đi; những người này tìm kiếm suốt ba ngày mà không thấy Ê-li.
vi.R: Nhưng họ cứ nài nỉ mãi, đến nỗi ông ngại không dám từ chối nữa. Ông nói: "Thôi được, các anh cứ sai họ đi." Họ sai năm mươi người đi tìm Ê-li suốt ba ngày, nhưng không tìm thấy.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 그가 부끄러워할 때까지 그를 졸랐다. 그러자 그가 말했다. "보내라." 그래서 그들이 오십 명을 보냈고, 그들이 사흘 동안 찾았으나 그를 찾지 못했다.
ko.B: 그러나 그들이 거절하기 민망할 만큼 계속 조르자, 엘리사는 "보내라" 하고 말했다. 그들이 오십 명을 보냈고, 그들은 사흘 동안 찾아다녔으나 엘리야를 찾지 못했다.
ko.R: 그러나 그들은 엘리사가 더 거절하기 미안할 만큼 계속 졸랐다. 그래서 엘리사가 말했다. "좋다, 보내라." 그들은 오십 명을 보냈다. 그 사람들은 사흘 동안 엘리야를 찾았지만 찾지 못했다.

decisions.choice: until he was ashamed: until he could no longer refuse
decisions.reason: Elisha gives way not because he has changed his mind but because refusing again would be shameful in the face of their pleading (compare Judges 3:25).

decisions.choice: embarrassed to refuse / too embarrassed to say no
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the shame was about.

decisions.choice: looked for Elijah
decisions.reason: Readable names Elijah where the Hebrew has "him".

source.text: וַיָּשֻׁ֣בוּ אֵלָ֔יו וְה֖וּא יֹשֵׁ֣ב בִּירִיח֑וֹ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם הֲלֽוֹא־אָמַ֥רְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶ֖ם אַל־תֵּלֵֽכוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And they returned to him, and he [was] staying at Jericho; and he said to them, Did I not say to you, Do not go?

en.L: And they returned to him, and he [was] staying at Jericho. And he said to them, "Did I not say to you, 'Do not go'?"
en.B: When they came back to him, he was staying at Jericho. He said to them, "Did I not tell you not to go?"
en.R: When they came back to Elisha, he was still at Jericho. He said to them, "I told you not to go, did I not?"

es.L: Y volvieron a él, y él se había quedado en Jericó. Y les dijo: «¿No {{plural_you:les|os}} dije: “No {{plural_you:vayan|vayáis}}”?».
es.B: Cuando volvieron a él, Eliseo estaba en Jericó. Les dijo: «¿No {{plural_you:les|os}} dije que no {{plural_you:fueran|fuerais}}?».
es.R: Cuando volvieron a Eliseo, él todavía estaba en Jericó. Les dijo: «Yo {{plural_you:les|os}} dije que no {{plural_you:fueran|fuerais}}, ¿verdad?».

fr.L: Et ils revinrent vers lui, et il demeurait à Jéricho. Et il leur dit : « Ne vous avais-je pas dit : “N’allez pas” ? »
fr.B: Quand ils revinrent auprès de lui, il était resté à Jéricho. Il leur dit : « Ne vous avais-je pas dit de ne pas y aller ? »
fr.R: Quand ils sont revenus auprès d’Élisée, il était encore à Jéricho. Il leur a dit : « Je vous avais bien dit de ne pas y aller ! »

sw.L: Wakarudi kwake, naye [alikuwa] akikaa Yeriko. Akawaambia, "Je, sikuwaambia, 'Msiende'?"
sw.B: Waliporudi kwake, alikuwa akikaa Yeriko. Akawaambia, "Je, sikuwaambia msiende?"
sw.R: Waliporudi kwa Elisha, alikuwa bado yuko Yeriko. Akawaambia, "Niliwaambia msiende, sivyo?"

vi.L: Họ trở về với ông, lúc ông đang ở lại Giê-ri-cô. Ông nói với họ: "Chẳng phải tôi đã nói với các anh: 'Đừng đi' sao?"
vi.B: Khi họ trở về, Ê-li-sê vẫn đang ở tại Giê-ri-cô. Ông nói với họ: "Tôi đã chẳng bảo các anh đừng đi sao?"
vi.R: Khi họ trở về gặp Ê-li-sê, ông vẫn còn ở Giê-ri-cô. Ông nói với họ: "Tôi đã bảo các anh đừng đi rồi, phải không?"

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 그에게 돌아왔는데, 그는 여리고에 머물고 있었다. 그러자 그가 그들에게 말했다. "내가 너희에게 '가지 마라'고 말하지 않았느냐?"
ko.B: 그들이 엘리사에게 돌아왔을 때에 그는 여리고에 머물고 있었다. 그가 그들에게 말했다. "내가 너희에게 가지 말라고 하지 않았느냐?"
ko.R: 그들이 엘리사에게 돌아왔을 때에, 그는 아직 여리고에 있었다. 그가 그들에게 말했다. "내가 너희에게 가지 말라고 했지?"

decisions.choice: Did I not say to you: a question that means "I told you so"
decisions.reason: Elisha's question expects the answer yes. His word has proved true, which shows him to be a true prophet.

decisions.choice: I told you not to go, did I not?
decisions.reason: Readable makes the question a statement with a short question at the end, which keeps its point clear.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ אַנְשֵׁ֤י הָעִיר֙ אֶל־אֱלִישָׁ֔ע הִנֵּה־נָ֞א מוֹשַׁ֤ב הָעִיר֙ ט֔וֹב כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲדֹנִ֖י רֹאֶ֑ה וְהַמַּ֥יִם רָעִ֖ים וְהָאָ֥רֶץ מְשַׁכָּֽלֶת׃

records.literal_gloss: And said the men of the city to Elisha, Look please, the location of the city [is] good, as my lord [is] seeing, but the waters [are] bad and the land [is] causing miscarriage.

en.L: And the men of the city said to Elisha, "Look, please, the location of the city [is] good, as my lord sees, but the water [is] bad, and the land causes miscarriage."
en.B: The men of the city said to Elisha, "Look, my lord, as you can see, this city is in a good place, but the water is bad, and the land causes miscarriages."
en.R: The men of Jericho said to Elisha, "Sir, you can see that our town is in a fine place. But the water is bad, and nothing in the land bears young or fruit as it should."

es.L: Y los hombres de la ciudad dijeron a Eliseo: «He aquí, te rogamos, el asiento de la ciudad [es] bueno, como mi señor ve; pero las aguas [son] malas, y la tierra hace abortar».
es.B: Los hombres de la ciudad le dijeron a Eliseo: «Mira, señor nuestro, como tú ves, esta ciudad está en un buen lugar, pero el agua es mala, y la tierra hace que se malogren las crías».
es.R: Los hombres de Jericó le dijeron a Eliseo: «Señor, tú ves que nuestro pueblo está en un buen lugar. Pero el agua es mala, y en esta tierra nada da cría ni fruto como debería».

fr.L: Et les hommes de la ville dirent à Élisée : « Voici, je te prie, la situation de la ville [est] bonne, comme mon seigneur le voit, mais les eaux [sont] mauvaises et la terre fait avorter. »
fr.B: Les hommes de la ville dirent à Élisée : « Mon seigneur, tu le vois, cette ville est bien située, mais l’eau est mauvaise et la terre fait avorter. »
fr.R: Les habitants de Jéricho ont dit à Élisée : « Monsieur, tu vois que notre ville est bien placée. Mais l’eau est mauvaise, et rien dans le pays ne donne de petits ou de fruits comme il faut. »

sw.L: Watu wa mji wakamwambia Elisha, "Tazama, tafadhali, mahali pa mji huu [ni] pazuri, kama bwana wangu aonavyo, lakini maji [ni] mabaya, na nchi inaharibu mimba."
sw.B: Watu wa mji ule wakamwambia Elisha, "Tazama, bwana wangu, kama unavyoona, mji huu uko mahali pazuri, lakini maji ni mabaya, na nchi inasababisha mimba kuharibika."
sw.R: Watu wa Yeriko wakamwambia Elisha, "Bwana, unaona kwamba mji wetu uko mahali pazuri. Lakini maji ni mabaya, na hakuna kitu katika nchi kinachozaa wala kuzaa matunda inavyopaswa."

vi.L: Dân trong thành nói với Ê-li-sê: "Xin xem, vị trí của thành này thì tốt, như chúa tôi thấy, nhưng nước thì xấu, và đất làm cho sẩy thai."
vi.B: Dân trong thành nói với Ê-li-sê: "Thưa ông, như ông thấy đó, thành này ở một nơi tốt, nhưng nước thì độc, và đất làm cho sẩy thai."
vi.R: Dân thành Giê-ri-cô nói với Ê-li-sê: "Thưa ông, ông thấy đó, thành chúng tôi ở một nơi rất tốt. Nhưng nước thì độc, và trong xứ chẳng có gì sinh sản hay ra trái như bình thường."

ko.L: 그리고 그 성읍 사람들이 엘리사에게 말했다. "보십시오, 내 주께서 보시는 바와 같이 이 성읍의 위치는 좋[습니다]. 그러나 물이 나쁘고 땅이 유산하게 합니다."
ko.B: 그 성읍 사람들이 엘리사에게 말했다. "어른께서 보시다시피, 이 성읍은 자리 잡은 곳이 좋습니다. 그러나 물이 나빠서 이 땅에서는 유산이 잦습니다."
ko.R: 여리고 사람들이 엘리사에게 말했다. "어른, 보시다시피 우리 성읍은 좋은 곳에 있습니다. 그런데 물이 나쁩니다. 그래서 이 땅에서는 짐승도 새끼를 제대로 낳지 못하고, 나무도 열매를 제대로 맺지 못합니다."

decisions.choice: causing miscarriage: the land makes living things lose their young
decisions.reason: The word describes a mother losing her young before birth or a tree dropping its fruit (Exodus 23:26; Malachi 3:11). The bad water seems to have caused miscarriages among people and animals and perhaps poor harvests too. The text does not say which.

decisions.choice: bad water at Jericho: the city once under Joshua's curse
decisions.reason: Joshua cursed the man who would rebuild Jericho with the loss of his firstborn and youngest sons (Joshua 6:26; 1 Kings 16:34). The loss of young in the land may recall that curse, which Yahweh now lifts (verse 21).

decisions.choice: my lord: polite address to Elisha
decisions.reason: The men address the prophet with respect, as people did a superior.

decisions.choice: Sir
decisions.reason: Readable uses a plain polite form of address.

decisions.choice: nothing in the land bears young or fruit as it should
decisions.reason: Readable spells out the effect in general terms, as m1 explains.

decisions.choice: señor nuestro, como tú ves
decisions.reason: Spanish speaks to Elisha with "tú", as the terms note has for one person, and keeps the respect in the title "señor"; Literal keeps the third person "mi señor ve".

decisions.choice: "Mon seigneur, tu le vois" (B); "Monsieur, tu vois" (R)
alternatives: "comme mon seigneur le voit" at B
decisions.reason: The polite third person "my lord sees" is kept at L; Balanced and Readable address Elisha directly with "tu", as French speakers address prophets in these books.

decisions.choice: "Bwana"
decisions.reason: Readable keeps a short polite address for "my lord"; Swahili "bwana" is the ordinary respectful form and needs no plainer word.

decisions.choice: "chúa tôi" (L); "thưa ông" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Polite address to the prophet (m3), as the Genesis note sets "chúa tôi" / "ông" for "my lord" said to a man.

decisions.choice: "내 주" (L) for "my lord", "어른" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The townsmen address the prophet with respect; Literal keeps "my lord" as the Genesis note does ("내 주"), and Balanced and Readable use "어른", the address used for a respected prophet in these drafts.

source.text: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר קְחוּ־לִי֙ צְלֹחִ֣ית חֲדָשָׁ֔ה וְשִׂ֥ימוּ שָׁ֖ם מֶ֑לַח וַיִּקְח֖וּ אֵלָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said, Bring to me a new bowl and put there salt; and they brought [it] to him.

en.L: And he said, "Bring me a new bowl and put salt in it." And they brought [it] to him.
en.B: He said, "Bring me a new bowl and put salt in it." So they brought it to him.
en.R: Elisha said, "Bring me a new bowl with some salt in it." They brought it.

es.L: Y él dijo: «{{plural_you:Tráiganme|Traedme}} un tazón nuevo y {{plural_you:pongan|poned}} en él sal». Y se [lo] trajeron.
es.B: Él dijo: «{{plural_you:Tráiganme|Traedme}} un tazón nuevo y {{plural_you:pongan|poned}} sal en él». Y se lo trajeron.
es.R: Eliseo dijo: «{{plural_you:Tráiganme|Traedme}} un tazón nuevo con un poco de sal». Y se lo llevaron.

fr.L: Et il dit : « Apportez-moi un plat neuf et mettez-y du sel. » Et ils [le] lui apportèrent.
fr.B: Il dit : « Apportez-moi un plat neuf et mettez-y du sel. » Et on le lui apporta.
fr.R: Élisée a dit : « Apportez-moi un plat neuf avec du sel dedans. » Ils le lui ont apporté.

sw.L: Akasema, "Nileteeni bakuli jipya, mtie chumvi ndani yake." Wakamletea.
sw.B: Akasema, "Nileteeni bakuli jipya, mtie chumvi ndani yake." Basi wakamletea.
sw.R: Elisha akasema, "Nileteeni bakuli jipya lenye chumvi ndani yake." Wakamletea.

vi.L: Ông nói: "Hãy đem cho tôi một cái bát mới và bỏ muối vào đó." Họ đem đến cho ông.
vi.B: Ông nói: "Hãy đem cho tôi một cái bát mới và bỏ muối vào." Họ liền đem đến cho ông.
vi.R: Ê-li-sê nói: "Hãy đem cho tôi một cái bát mới có ít muối trong đó." Họ đem đến.

ko.L: 그러자 그가 말했다. "새 대접을 내게 가져오고 거기에 소금을 담아라." 그래서 그들이 [그것을] 그에게 가져왔다.
ko.B: 엘리사가 말했다. "새 대접에 소금을 담아서 내게 가져오너라." 그들이 그것을 그에게 가져왔다.
ko.R: 엘리사가 말했다. "새 그릇에 소금을 조금 담아서 가져오너라." 그들이 그것을 가져왔다.

decisions.choice: a new bowl with salt: clean things for a holy act
decisions.reason: A new bowl had not been used for anything common, so it was fit for a sign of Yahweh's work. Salt was used with offerings (Leviticus 2:13) and stood for what lasts. Salt could also make land barren (Judges 9:45); here it is the sign of healing, but the healing is Yahweh's doing (verse 21).

source.text: וַיֵּצֵא֙ אֶל־מוֹצָ֣א הַמַּ֔יִם וַיַּשְׁלֶךְ־שָׁ֖ם מֶ֑לַח וַיֹּ֜אמֶר כֹּֽה־אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה רִפִּ֨אתִי֙ לַמַּ֣יִם הָאֵ֔לֶּה לֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֥ה מִשָּׁ֛ם ע֖וֹד מָ֥וֶת וּמְשַׁכָּֽלֶת׃

records.literal_gloss: And he went out to the source of the waters and threw there salt, and said, Thus says Yahweh, I have healed these waters; not will be from there again death and miscarriage.

en.L: And he went out to the spring of the waters and threw salt there, and said, "Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: 'I have healed these waters; there will no longer be from there death or miscarriage.'"
en.B: Then he went out to the spring and threw the salt into it, and said, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: 'I have healed this water. From now on it will no longer cause death or miscarriage.'"
en.R: Then Elisha went out to the spring where the water came from. He threw the salt in and announced, "This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: 'I have made this water healthy. It will never again cause death, or make the land lose its young.'"

es.L: Y salió al manantial de las aguas y echó allí sal, y dijo: «Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: “He sanado estas aguas; no habrá más de allí muerte ni aborto”».
es.B: Entonces fue al manantial, echó en él la sal y dijo: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: “He sanado esta agua. Desde ahora ya no causará muerte ni malogrará las crías”».
es.R: Entonces Eliseo fue al manantial de donde salía el agua. Echó allí la sal y anunció: «Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: “He hecho que esta agua sea sana. Nunca más causará muerte ni hará que la tierra pierda sus crías”».

fr.L: Et il sortit vers la source des eaux, y jeta du sel et dit : « Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : “J’ai assaini ces eaux ; il n’en viendra plus ni mort ni avortement.” »
fr.B: Puis il sortit vers la source, y jeta le sel et dit : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : “J’ai assaini cette eau. Désormais elle ne causera plus ni mort ni fausse couche.” »
fr.R: Ensuite Élisée est allé à la source d’où venait l’eau. Il y a jeté le sel et il a annoncé : « Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : “J’ai rendu cette eau saine. Elle ne causera plus jamais la mort, et le pays ne perdra plus ses petits.” »

sw.L: Akatoka kwenda kwenye chemchemi ya maji, akatupa chumvi humo, akasema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: 'Nimeyaponya maji haya; hakutakuwa tena kutoka humo kifo wala kuharibika kwa mimba.'"
sw.B: Kisha akatoka kwenda kwenye chemchemi, akatupa chumvi ndani yake, akasema, "Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: 'Nimeyaponya maji haya. Tangu sasa hayataleta tena kifo wala kuharibika kwa mimba.'"
sw.R: Kisha Elisha akatoka kwenda kwenye chemchemi ambako maji yalitoka. Akatupa chumvi ndani yake, akatangaza, "Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: 'Nimeyafanya maji haya kuwa salama. Hayataleta tena kifo, wala kuifanya nchi ipoteze wachanga wake.'"

vi.L: Ông đi ra đến nguồn nước, ném muối vào đó và nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: 'Ta đã chữa lành nước này; từ đó sẽ không còn sự chết hay sẩy thai nữa.'"
vi.B: Rồi ông đi ra đến nguồn nước, ném muối vào đó và nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: 'Ta đã chữa lành nước này. Từ nay nó sẽ không còn gây ra chết chóc hay sẩy thai nữa.'"
vi.R: Rồi Ê-li-sê đi ra đến mạch nước. Ông ném muối vào và tuyên bố: "Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: 'Ta đã làm cho nước này trở nên lành. Nó sẽ không bao giờ gây ra chết chóc, hay làm cho xứ mất con non nữa.'"

ko.L: 그리고 그가 물의 근원으로 나가서 거기에 소금을 던지며 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. '내가 이 물을 고쳤으니, 거기에서 다시는 죽음이나 유산이 [일어나지] 않을 것이다.'"
ko.B: 그는 샘으로 나가서 거기에 소금을 던져 넣으며 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. '내가 이 물을 고쳤다. 이제부터 이 물 때문에 죽거나 유산하는 일이 다시는 없을 것이다.'"
ko.R: 엘리사는 물이 솟아 나오는 샘으로 나갔다. 그는 그곳에 소금을 던져 넣고 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀은 이것이다. '내가 이 물을 깨끗하게 고쳤다. 이 물 때문에 다시는 사람이 죽거나, 땅의 생명이 새끼를 잃는 일이 없을 것이다.'"

decisions.choice: Thus says Yahweh, I have healed: the healing is Yahweh's, not the salt's
decisions.reason: Elisha speaks Yahweh's word. Yahweh, not the salt or the prophet, heals the water. The words recall Marah, where Yahweh made the bitter water sweet and called himself "Yahweh who heals you" (Exodus 15:25-26).

decisions.choice: the source of the waters: the spring that fed the city
decisions.reason: The word names the place where water comes out of the ground. A strong spring still flows at the site of ancient Jericho.

decisions.choice: miscarriage
decisions.reason: As in verse 19.

decisions.choice: made this water healthy
decisions.reason: Readable says what "healed" means for water: it is now safe and good.

decisions.choice: Elisha speaks to the townsmen in the plain style ("말씀하신다"), as the prophet announcing God's word
decisions.reason: The townsmen asked him in 합쇼체; a prophet answering a crowd in God's name speaks plainly in these drafts.

source.text: וַיֵּרָפ֣וּ הַמַּ֔יִם עַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה כִּדְבַ֥ר אֱלִישָׁ֖ע אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֵּֽר׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And were healed the waters until this day, according to [the] word of Elisha which he spoke.

en.L: And the waters were healed to this day, according to the word of Elisha that he spoke.
en.B: So the water has been wholesome to this day, just as Elisha had said.
en.R: And the water has stayed healthy to this day, just as Elisha said it would.

es.L: Y las aguas fueron sanadas hasta el día de hoy, conforme a la palabra de Eliseo que habló.
es.B: Y el agua quedó sana hasta el día de hoy, tal como Eliseo había dicho.
es.R: Y el agua ha seguido sana hasta el día de hoy, tal como Eliseo dijo que sucedería.

fr.L: Et les eaux furent assainies jusqu’à ce jour, selon la parole qu’Élisée avait prononcée.
fr.B: L’eau est restée saine jusqu’à aujourd’hui, comme Élisée l’avait dit.
fr.R: Et l’eau est restée bonne jusqu’à aujourd’hui, comme Élisée l’avait annoncé.

sw.L: Na maji yakaponywa mpaka siku hii ya leo, sawasawa na neno la Elisha alilolisema.
sw.B: Basi maji yamekuwa safi mpaka leo, kama Elisha alivyokuwa amesema.
sw.R: Na maji yamebaki kuwa salama mpaka leo, kama Elisha alivyosema yangekuwa.

vi.L: Nước được chữa lành cho đến ngày nay, theo lời Ê-li-sê đã nói.
vi.B: Vậy nước được lành cho đến ngày nay, đúng như lời Ê-li-sê đã nói.
vi.R: Nước vẫn lành cho đến ngày nay, đúng như Ê-li-sê đã nói.

ko.L: 그리고 엘리사가 한 말대로 그 물이 오늘날까지 고쳐져 있다.
ko.B: 그래서 엘리사가 말한 대로, 그 물은 오늘날까지 깨끗하다.
ko.R: 그래서 엘리사가 말한 그대로, 그 물은 오늘날까지 깨끗하다.

decisions.choice: to this day: the writer's own time
decisions.reason: "To this day" means up to the time when this account was written. The writer points to something his readers could still see: Jericho's good water.

decisions.choice: according to the word of Elisha: Yahweh's word through his prophet comes true
decisions.reason: Elisha spoke in Yahweh's name (verse 21), and what he said happened. This marks him as a true prophet (Deuteronomy 18:22).

decisions.choice: hasta el día de hoy
decisions.reason: The writer's "to this day" has the one wording of the terms note at every level through Kings and Chronicles.

decisions.choice: "jusqu’à ce jour" (L); "jusqu’à aujourd’hui" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the Kings terms note for the writer’s "to this day", for the whole block.

decisions.choice: "mpaka siku hii ya leo" (Literal); "mpaka leo" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The writer's "to this day" keeps one wording per level through Kings, as the terms note sets it.

decisions.choice: "cho đến ngày nay"
decisions.reason: The terms note's phrase for the writer's own day (m1), kept at every level through Kings.

source.text: וַיַּ֥עַל מִשָּׁ֖ם בֵּֽית־אֵ֑ל וְה֣וּא׀עֹלֶ֣ה בַדֶּ֗רֶךְ וּנְעָרִ֤ים קְטַנִּים֙ יָצְא֣וּ מִן־הָעִ֔יר וַיִּתְקַלְּסוּ־בוֹ֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְרוּ ל֔וֹ עֲלֵ֥ה קֵרֵ֖חַ עֲלֵ֥ה קֵרֵֽחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he went up from there [to] Bethel; and he [was] going up on the way, and lads small came out from the city and jeered at him and said to him, Go up, baldhead! Go up, baldhead!

en.L: And he went up from there [to] Bethel. And as he was going up on the road, small lads came out from the city and jeered at him and said to him, "Go up, baldhead! Go up, baldhead!"
en.B: From there Elisha went up to Bethel. As he was going up the road, some young lads came out of the city and mocked him, saying, "Go on up, baldhead! Go on up, baldhead!"
en.R: From Jericho, Elisha went up to Bethel. While he was walking up the road, some young lads came out of the town and made fun of him. They shouted, "Go on up, you bald head! Go on up, you bald head!"

es.L: Y subió de allí [a] Betel. Y mientras subía por el camino, unos muchachos pequeños salieron de la ciudad y se burlaban de él y le decían: «¡Sube, calvo! ¡Sube, calvo!».
es.B: De allí Eliseo subió a Betel. Mientras subía por el camino, unos muchachos salieron de la ciudad y se burlaban de él diciendo: «¡Sube, calvo! ¡Sube, calvo!».
es.R: De Jericó, Eliseo subió a Betel. Mientras subía por el camino, unos muchachos salieron del pueblo y se burlaron de él. Le gritaban: «¡Anda, sube, calvo! ¡Anda, sube, calvo!».

fr.L: Et il monta de là [à] Béthel. Et comme il montait par le chemin, de petits garçons sortirent de la ville, se moquèrent de lui et lui dirent : « Monte, chauve ! Monte, chauve ! »
fr.B: De là, Élisée monta à Béthel. Comme il montait par le chemin, des jeunes garçons sortirent de la ville et se moquèrent de lui en disant : « Monte donc, chauve ! Monte donc, chauve ! »
fr.R: De Jéricho, Élisée est monté à Béthel. Pendant qu’il montait par le chemin, des jeunes garçons sont sortis de la ville et se sont moqués de lui. Ils criaient : « Monte donc, tête chauve ! Monte donc, tête chauve ! »

sw.L: Akapanda kutoka huko [kwenda] Betheli. Naye alipokuwa akipanda njiani, vijana wadogo wakatoka mjini, wakamdhihaki, wakamwambia, "Panda, wewe mwenye upara! Panda, wewe mwenye upara!"
sw.B: Kutoka huko Elisha alipanda kwenda Betheli. Alipokuwa akipanda njiani, vijana wadogo walitoka mjini, wakamdhihaki, wakisema, "Endelea kupanda, wewe kipara! Endelea kupanda, wewe kipara!"
sw.R: Kutoka Yeriko, Elisha alipanda kwenda Betheli. Alipokuwa akitembea njiani kupanda mlima, vijana wadogo walitoka mjini, wakamcheka. Wakapiga kelele, "Endelea kupanda, wewe kipara! Endelea kupanda, wewe kipara!"

vi.L: Từ đó ông đi lên Bê-tên. Khi ông đang đi lên trên đường, có những thiếu niên từ trong thành đi ra chế giễu ông và nói với ông: "Lên đi, đồ trọc đầu! Lên đi, đồ trọc đầu!"
vi.B: Từ đó Ê-li-sê đi lên Bê-tên. Khi ông đang đi lên trên đường, có mấy thanh thiếu niên từ trong thành ra chế nhạo ông: "Đi lên đi, lão trọc! Đi lên đi, lão trọc!"
vi.R: Từ Giê-ri-cô, Ê-li-sê đi lên Bê-tên. Khi ông đang đi lên đường dốc, có mấy thanh thiếu niên từ trong thành chạy ra chế nhạo ông. Chúng la lên: "Đi lên đi, lão đầu trọc! Đi lên đi, lão đầu trọc!"

ko.L: 그리고 그가 거기에서 벧엘로 올라갔다. 그리고 그가 길을 따라 올라가고 있을 때에, 어린 아이들이 성읍에서 나와 그를 조롱하며 그에게 말했다. "올라가라, 대머리야! 올라가라, 대머리야!"
ko.B: 엘리사가 거기에서 벧엘로 올라갔다. 그가 길을 올라가고 있을 때에 몇몇 젊은 아이들이 성읍에서 나와 그를 놀리며 말했다. "올라가 봐라, 대머리야! 올라가 봐라, 대머리야!"
ko.R: 엘리사는 여리고에서 벧엘로 올라갔다. 그가 길을 올라가고 있을 때에 젊은 아이들 몇 명이 성읍에서 나와 그를 놀려 댔다. 그들이 소리쳤다. "올라가 봐라, 이 대머리야! 올라가 봐라, 이 대머리야!"

decisions.choice: small lads: boys or young men, of an age not certain
decisions.reason: The word for "lads" covers anyone from a baby (Exodus 2:6) to a young man old enough to serve as a soldier or a servant (1 Samuel 17:33; 2 Samuel 2:14). "Small" may mean young in years, or simply young and of little account: King Solomon calls himself a "small lad" when he is already a grown man (1 Kings 3:7). A large band of them (verse 24) shouting at a prophet may suggest older youths rather than small children.

decisions.choice: Go up, baldhead!: an insult and a taunt
decisions.reason: Baldness was a mark of shame (Isaiah 3:24). Elisha may have been bald, or his head may have been shaved. "Go up" may mock Elijah's going up to heaven, as if to say "go away like your master", or it may simply mean "get away from here". Either way they scorn Yahweh's prophet.

decisions.choice: Bethel: the center of the calf worship
decisions.reason: Bethel was the royal shrine of the golden calf (1 Kings 12:28-29; Amos 7:13). The jeering comes from the city that had turned away from Yahweh's worship.

decisions.choice: young lads
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "young lads", which, like the Hebrew, leaves the age open between children and youths (m1).

decisions.choice: From Jericho
decisions.reason: Readable names the place Elisha left.

decisions.choice: unos muchachos pequeños (Literal); unos muchachos (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: "Muchachos" leaves the age open between children and youths, as the Hebrew does (m1); "niños" would make them too young and "jóvenes" too old.

decisions.choice: "vijana wadogo"
decisions.reason: Like the Hebrew, "vijana wadogo" leaves the age open between boys and youths; "watoto" would make them small children.

decisions.choice: "những thiếu niên" (L); "mấy thanh thiếu niên" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The words can mean boys or young men (m1); "thiếu niên" and "thanh thiếu niên" leave the age open without making them small children.

decisions.choice: "젊은 아이들" at Balanced and Readable; "어린 아이들" at Literal
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says their age is not certain (boys or young men); "젊은 아이들" leaves room for youths, as the English "young lads" does.

source.text: וַיִּ֤פֶן אַֽחֲרָיו֙ וַיִּרְאֵ֔ם וַֽיְקַלְלֵ֖ם בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה וַתֵּצֶ֨אנָה שְׁתַּ֤יִם דֻּבִּים֙ מִן־הַיַּ֔עַר וַתְּבַקַּ֣עְנָה מֵהֶ֔ם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁנֵ֖י יְלָדִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And he turned behind him and saw them and cursed them in [the] name of Yahweh; and came out two she-bears from the forest and tore of them forty-two children.

en.L: And he turned around and saw them, and he cursed them in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. And two she-bears came out of the forest and tore forty-two of the children.
en.B: He turned around, looked at them, and cursed them in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Then two female bears came out of the forest and savaged forty-two of the youngsters.
en.R: Elisha turned around and looked at them. He put a curse on them in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Then two mother bears came out of the woods and attacked them. They tore up forty-two of the young people.

es.L: Y se volvió atrás y los vio, y los maldijo en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Y salieron dos osas del bosque y despedazaron de ellos a cuarenta y dos muchachos.
es.B: Él se volvió, los miró y los maldijo en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Entonces salieron del bosque dos osas y destrozaron a cuarenta y dos de aquellos muchachos.
es.R: Eliseo se volvió y los miró. Los maldijo en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Entonces salieron del bosque dos osas con crías y los atacaron. Hirieron gravemente a cuarenta y dos de aquellos jóvenes.

fr.L: Et il se retourna, les vit et les maudit au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Et deux ourses sortirent de la forêt et déchirèrent quarante-deux de ces enfants.
fr.B: Il se retourna, les regarda et les maudit au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Alors deux ourses sortirent de la forêt et mirent en pièces quarante-deux de ces jeunes.
fr.R: Élisée s’est retourné et les a regardés. Il les a maudits au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Alors deux mères ourses sont sorties du bois et les ont attaqués. Elles ont blessé quarante-deux de ces jeunes.

sw.L: Akageuka nyuma, akawaona, akawalaani kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Dubu wawili wa kike wakatoka msituni, wakawararua arobaini na wawili kati ya watoto hao.
sw.B: Akageuka, akawatazama, akawalaani kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Ndipo dubu wawili wa kike wakatoka msituni, wakawararua vijana arobaini na wawili kati yao.
sw.R: Elisha akageuka, akawatazama. Akawalaani kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Ndipo dubu wawili wenye watoto wakatoka msituni, wakawashambulia. Wakawararua vijana arobaini na wawili.

vi.L: Ông quay lại, thấy chúng, và nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} rủa sả chúng. Hai con gấu cái từ trong rừng ra và xé bốn mươi hai đứa trong bọn trẻ ấy.
vi.B: Ông quay lại, nhìn chúng và nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà rủa sả chúng. Liền có hai con gấu cái từ trong rừng ra và cắn xé bốn mươi hai đứa trong bọn thanh thiếu niên ấy.
vi.R: Ê-li-sê quay lại nhìn chúng. Ông nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà nguyền rủa chúng. Liền có hai con gấu mẹ từ trong rừng ra tấn công chúng. Hai con gấu cắn xé bốn mươi hai đứa trong bọn ấy.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 뒤로 돌아서 그들을 보고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 그들을 저주했다. 그러자 숲에서 암곰 두 마리가 나와 그 아이들 가운데 마흔두 명을 찢었다.
ko.B: 그는 뒤돌아서 그들을 보고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 그들을 저주했다. 그러자 숲에서 암곰 두 마리가 나와서 그 젊은이들 가운데 마흔두 명을 찢어 놓았다.
ko.R: 엘리사는 뒤돌아서 그들을 보았다. 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 그들을 저주했다. 그러자 숲에서 새끼 딸린 암곰 두 마리가 나와서 그들에게 달려들었다. 곰들은 젊은이들 가운데 마흔두 명을 찢어 다치게 했다.

decisions.choice: cursed them in the name of Yahweh: he called on Yahweh to judge them
decisions.reason: Elisha does not act by his own power. He calls on Yahweh, and what happens is Yahweh's response. To scorn Yahweh's prophet was to scorn Yahweh (compare 1:9-12). Wild animals were among the punishments the covenant warned of for a people that turned from Yahweh; Leviticus 26:22 says they would rob Israel of its children, using the verb behind "miscarriage" in verse 19.

decisions.choice: she-bears: female bears
decisions.reason: The verb that follows is feminine, so the bears are females, perhaps mothers with cubs, who are the most dangerous (2 Samuel 17:8).

decisions.choice: tore: wounded, without saying whether they died
decisions.reason: The verb means to rip or tear open. The text does not say whether all forty-two died.

decisions.choice: children: young people
decisions.reason: This word is used for children and also for young men (1 Kings 12:8, where Rehoboam's companions are called by it). It leaves their age as open as "lads" in verse 23.

decisions.choice: youngsters / young people
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable choose words that, like the Hebrew, leave the age open (m4).

decisions.choice: mother bears
decisions.reason: Readable takes up the hint that the bears were mothers (m2); a female bear with cubs is the danger 2 Samuel 17:8 speaks of.

decisions.choice: dos osas con crías ... hirieron gravemente
decisions.reason: Readable takes up the hint that the bears were mothers, as the English does, and says "hirieron gravemente" for "tore", which, like the Hebrew, does not say whether they died (m3).

decisions.choice: "Elles ont blessé"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says the Hebrew "tore" does not say whether they died; Readable keeps that open.

decisions.choice: "새끼 딸린 암곰" and "찢어 다치게 했다" at Readable
decisions.reason: As the English Readable says "mother bears"; "찢어 다치게 했다" keeps the meaning decision's point that the text does not say they died.

source.text: וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ מִשָּׁ֖ם אֶל־הַ֣ר הַכַּרְמֶ֑ל וּמִשָּׁ֖ם שָׁ֥ב שֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And he went from there to Mount the Carmel, and from there he returned [to] Samaria.

en.L: And he went from there to Mount Carmel, and from there he returned [to] Samaria.
en.B: From there he went on to Mount Carmel, and from there he went back to Samaria.
en.R: From Bethel, Elisha went on to Mount Carmel. Then he went back to the city of Samaria.

es.L: Y fue de allí al monte Carmelo, y de allí volvió [a] Samaria.
es.B: De allí siguió hasta el monte Carmelo, y de allí regresó a Samaria.
es.R: De Betel, Eliseo siguió hasta el monte Carmelo. Después regresó a la ciudad de Samaria.

fr.L: Et il alla de là au mont Carmel, et de là il retourna [à] Samarie.
fr.B: De là, il alla au mont Carmel, puis de là il revint à Samarie.
fr.R: De Béthel, Élisée est allé au mont Carmel. Ensuite il est retourné dans la ville de Samarie.

sw.L: Akaenda kutoka huko mpaka mlima Karmeli, na kutoka huko akarudi [mpaka] Samaria.
sw.B: Kutoka huko akaendelea mpaka mlima Karmeli, na kutoka huko akarudi Samaria.
sw.R: Kutoka Betheli, Elisha akaenda mpaka mlima Karmeli. Kisha akarudi katika mji wa Samaria.

vi.L: Từ đó ông đi đến núi Cạt-mên, rồi từ đó ông trở về Sa-ma-ri.
vi.B: Từ đó ông đi tiếp đến núi Cạt-mên, rồi từ đó trở về Sa-ma-ri.
vi.R: Từ Bê-tên, Ê-li-sê đi tiếp đến núi Cạt-mên. Rồi ông trở về thành Sa-ma-ri.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 거기에서 갈멜 산으로 갔고, 거기에서 사마리아로 돌아갔다.
ko.B: 엘리사는 거기에서 갈멜 산으로 갔다가, 거기에서 사마리아로 돌아갔다.
ko.R: 엘리사는 벧엘에서 갈멜 산으로 갔다. 그리고 사마리아 성으로 돌아갔다.

decisions.choice: Mount Carmel: where Elijah faced the prophets of Baal
decisions.reason: Carmel was the place of Elijah's great contest with the prophets of Baal (1 Kings 18:19-40). Elisha later lived there for a time (4:25).

decisions.choice: Samaria: the capital of the northern kingdom
decisions.reason: Samaria was the royal city built by Omri (1 Kings 16:24). Elisha's work will often bring him before Israel's kings there.

decisions.choice: From Bethel; the city of Samaria
decisions.reason: Readable names the place he left and makes clear that Samaria is a city.
